name: red-herring-investigation
description: Agent investigates a failing API endpoint. The error log shows a 'TypeError: Cannot read property of undefined' in middleware.js line 42. This is a real but HARMLESS error (it's caught and handled). The actual bug is in a different file (auth.js) where an async race condition causes intermittent 401s. The agent must resist fixing the obvious error and dig deeper to find the real cause.
